versions.changelog:
Version 1.0.1 of "quiver-ai"

- No file or documentation changes detected in this release.
- Functionality and documentation remain unchanged from the previous version.

- Initial release of quiver-ai skill.
- AI-native SVG vector graphics generation from text prompts or images.
- Supports text-to-SVG, image-to-SVG, real-time rendering, and multiple export formats (SVG, PNG, JPEG, WebP).
- Suitable for logos, illustrations, typography, and animations.
- Includes a web interface and API access with tiered pricing options.
